races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: UNFLINCHING made his 2m hurdle debut in what turned out to be a very strong maiden at Limerick last Christmas and is taken to come good on return stepped up to a trip which is sure to suit. Henry de Bromhead's Midtown Manhattan should have more to offer now stepping back up in trip and is second choice ahead of the more-established Young Doran . UNFLINCHING (FR) MIDTOWN MANHATTAN (IRE) YOUNG DORAN (IRE)

races.display_title: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: ROKANAKO sets the standard among those with experience and may get off the mark under Michael Kenneally. Hurdling debutant Don't Hold Back is potentially interesting in a weak race, while S T Hamo faces a more realistic assignment than on his hurdling bow last week. races.verdict: Gordon Elliott has taken this prize in 2 of the past 3 years and his Poet's Word gelding GREENBRIER , placed on his sole run in a point, is taken to add to the tally with last year's winning rider Harry Swan in the saddle again. Red Seagull rates the pick of those with experience and is next on the list ahead of River Cartwright and Distraction . GREENBRIER (IRE) RED SEAGULL (IRE) RIVER CARTWRIGHT (IRE)

races.display_title: CSP Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: PRESLEY shaped with plenty of promise in a couple of bumpers last season, building on his debut effort despite his exuberance when second at Warwick in March. Moments Away and useful Flat performer Insanity are also respected. PRESLEY (IRE) MERLIN ALLEN (FR) MOMENTS AWAY (IRE)

races.verdict: NAN'S CHOICE 's Grade 2 bumper success at Aintree on her first outing for Dan Skelton marks her down as one who could go a long way over hurdles. races.verdict: Lots with chances. MOON CHIME was in the process of running really well (still in front) when falling at the last in the Silver Trophy at Chepstow on his return and this winning stayer on the Flat is worth siding with on his first try over this 3m trip. Recent Ffos Las scorer Kilwaughter heads the list of dangers, although a good case can also be made for the likes of Bill Baxter , Splendid Fellow and Western Monkey in this fascinating handicap. The Jukebox Kid completes the shortlist. MOON CHIME KILWAUGHTER (IRE) BILL BAXTER (IRE)

races.verdict: PERCY DE COURCY looked a good prospect when scoring easily on his sole points run so is taken to make a winning start in this sphere now starting out for the all-conquering Skelton team. Spare The Voice was also successful on his only outing in points so could emerge as the main danger on his debut for Nick Scholfield ahead of Grand Teton and Coolnav who rate the pick of those with experience. PERCY DE COURCY SPARE THE VOICE (IRE) GRAND TETON (IRE)

races.display_title: BetVictor Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: No form to go on but lots of potential in this closing bumper and the market should reveal plenty. Dan Skelton's Doyen gelding NEWGROVE was an impressive winner on his only run in an Irish point in the spring and gets the nod over Geissler who hails from a yard with a good record in this event. Treble Three and Radiant Walk are also in excellent hands and need factoring in, too. NEWGROVE (IRE) GEISSLER (IRE) TREBLE THREE (IRE)

races.display_title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
races.verdict: BENACRE is well handicapped on last winter's form and could prove a different proposition with visor applied and freshened up by a break. He therefore looks worth chancing. Lillie Margot has a solid-looking profile and shouldn't be far away, while Orangesandlemons won over C&D in the past and may do better down in grade. BENACRE (IRE) LILLIE MARGOT ORANGESANDLEMONS

races.display_title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FENAROLI shaped with plenty of promise when third behind a couple boasting prior experience at Kempton 4 weeks ago, coming from much further back than that pair in the process. Very well bred and looking sure to improve, this looks a good opening for Harry Charlton's colt. Bombora is very much a work in progress but Karl Burke's colt may well still emerge as the chief threat. FENAROLI BOMBORA KNIGHTBOLT (IRE)

races.display_title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: RIBENSKA 's best efforts have come on all-weather and with this return to 7f sure to be in her favour, Charlie Fellowes' 4-y-o gets the tentative nod to double her tally from a sliding mark at the expense of Enola Grey , who looked unlucky not to finish closer at Wolverhampton recently. Course winner Spirit of Jenny rounds off the shortlist. RIBENSKA (IRE) ENOLA GREY (IRE) SPIRIT OF JENNY (IRE)

races.display_title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict: BAJAN BANDIT 's recent victories have come at a lower level than this, yet he was a ready winner on the latest of them at Wolverhampton 9 days ago and, escaping a penalty, he may well take some stepping from a good draw in this form. Havana Touch has done well on all-weather this year and he commands plenty of respect too, with Nakaaha and The Hare Rail completing the shortlist. BAJAN BANDIT HAVANA TOUCH NAKAAHA
